# Tests

<!-- Generated by tools/run_tests.py --write-index from tools/test_map.json; do not edit manually. -->

Run the tests for what you changed with `py -3 tools/run_tests.py --changed` (vs origin/main, including uncommitted files). A changed path that no test claims runs ALL tests.
Use `--all`, `--only ID`, `--kind python|godot`, `--list` or `--dry-run`. `<godot>` is `godot_executable` in `.agents/planner/config.json` (override: `--godot` or `GODOT_EXECUTABLE`).
Passing tests do not certify artistic similarity. [Full file listing](FILES.md).

| Test | Kind | Covers | Command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_costs` | python | Claude/Codex token and cost receipts, leaderboard and hooks. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_agent_costs.py` |
| `agent_workflow` | python | Task/art tracking records, generated dashboards, code/graphics boundary and deduplication. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_agent_workflow.py` |
| `art_delivery` | python | Alpha-capable PNG headers without image decoding and QA signoff guard. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_art_delivery.py` |
| `goal_task_factory` | python | Goal planner evidence, deduplication, manual requests, agent routing and claim safeguards. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_goal_task_factory.py` |
| `local_planner` | python | Local-only planning proposals and setup defaults. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_local_planner.py` |
| `parallel_safety` | python | Task touch isolation, anti-art boundaries, no-code-run default, rollback guard, goal costs. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_parallel_safety.py` |
| `runner_main_clean` | python | Runner leaves main clean: regenerated files committed after merge, stray changes blocked, scheduled worker log. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_runner_main_clean.py` |
| `project_indexes` | python | Deterministic FILES.md inventory generation. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_project_indexes.py` |
| `map_factory` | python | Baseline map versioning and factory operations. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_map_factory.py` |
| `map_cardinal` | python | Four directions, sprite selection and mounted offsets. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_map_cardinal.py` |
| `map_floor_geometry` | python | Floor geometry. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_map_floor_geometry.py` |
| `map_floor_style` | python | Floor style and tiling. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_map_floor_style.py` |
| `map_intake` | python | Map intake and asset import. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_map_intake.py` |
| `map_layers` | python | Five-layer composition and block mount rules. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_map_layers.py` |

| `lf_writers` | python | Every tools/*.py writer emits LF (newline="\n", csv lineterminator) so Windows leaves no CRLF diffs. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_lf_writers.py` |
| `map_registry_validate` | python | Every published map version and latest registry hash. | `python tools/map_factory_cli.py validate` |
| `test_router` | python | Test router: glob matching, changed-path selection, unmatched fallback, map coverage. | `python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p test_run_tests.py` |

| `godot_import` | godot | Godot headless resource import and script parse. | `<godot> --headless --path . --editor --quit` |
